g.title: Domain
g.text: Persistent identity, explicit state inheritance, composed roles

g.title: Note
g.text: AgentIdentity stays the same; historical values stay immutable.
Roles are optional assignments, not permanent agent subclasses.
Human and Zombie deaths retain their terminal state variant.

g.title: Legend
g.text: Hollow triangle: inheritance • filled diamond: owns
Open diamond: shared definition • dashed arrow: reference
Selected target classes; value objects/codecs omitted for readability.
